data.title: Michael Saylor tells investors when Strategy's Bitcoin no longer covers its debt
data.description: Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR) has launched a public tool that shows investors exactly how well its Bitcoin holdings cover the money it owes, a move toward greater transparency about the risks on its balance sheet. Executive chairman Michael Saylor announced the Bitcoin Credit Model on Aug. 12. Strategy ...
